sources.title: Claude Fable 5.1
sources.evidence: Exact claude-fable-5-1 identifier; released September 1, 2026; 1M context; adaptive thinking always on; text/image input and text output; intended for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. Reopened October 27: specifications and current comparison table disclose context, output, price, latency and thinking settings, but no nominal total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Models overview
sources.evidence: Identifies Anthropic as Claude's developer and lists Fable 5.1 among current models, all supporting tool use.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing; PDFs are processed through text and vision. Together with the active exact-model page, supports PDF as an accepted input format.

sources.title: Claude Fable
sources.evidence: The Fable product line lists Fable 5.1's introduction on September 1, 2026 and access through Claude subscriptions, Claude Platform and partner services.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The terms govern Anthropic API services, grant permission to use services subject to restrictions and reserve intellectual-property rights. Supports a descriptive proprietary classification for the hosted offering, not a named open-weight license.

sources.title: Anthropic's Transparency Hub
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 share the same underlying model with different safeguards. The architecture/training sections describe pretraining and post-training, but give neither a nominal total/active parameter count nor a named, sized base from which to infer one.

sources.title: Model system cards
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. Current index lists the Fable/Mythos 5.1 card and subsequent Opus, Sonnet and Haiku 5.5 cards; all three later originals were checked for Fable 5.1 size comparisons.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently retrieved original 230-page later card and searched full text for exact-model comparison disclosures. No production parameter count or architecture class found; parameter hits concern inference settings and the architecture reference concerns a benchmark task.

sources.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
sources.evidence: Read October 27. Identifies Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 as the same model with different safeguards. Its comparison table reports benchmark results, not parameter totals or active counts. Fable 5 is called a predecessor, but no named, sized base or size-preserving training relationship is supplied. Anti-distillation discussion describes protective mechanisms, not distillation of Fable 5.1 from another model.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5.1 & Claude Mythos 5.1 System Card (official endpoint, fresh parameter review)
sources.evidence: Independently read the 212-page original full text retrieved at 2026-10-27T10:18:48.980908+00:00 in the shared primary cache (model-103-card.txt). Introduction explicitly identifies identical model weights; sections 4 and 6 distinguish surrounding safeguards. Training section describes pretraining/post-training without a named, sized base. Full-text search and contextual inspection find no nominal total or active parameter specification; parameter hits concern inference settings, and ESM-2 references are benchmark resources.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5 & Claude Mythos 5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the 319-page predecessor card from the official source retrieved at 2026-10-27T10:18:49.072570+00:00 (model-096-card.txt). Fable 5/Mythos 5 share weights, but no nominal total or active parameter count is provided. It supplies no published size to transfer to Fable 5.1; PEFT, fine-tuning and distillation mentions describe safeguards/evaluations rather than a sized production-model lineage.

sources.title: Claude Mythos 5.1 official specifications
sources.evidence: Read October 27 to resolve the explicit same-model lead. Calls Mythos 5.1 Fable 5.1 for verified organizations. Its exact-model specifications and comparison table contain context, output, price, latency, thinking and cutoff columns, but no total or activated-parameter count.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card (official endpoint, fresh comparison review)
sources.evidence: Independently searched all 230 pages from the official document retrieved at 2026-10-27T10:11:48.808248+00:00. The card contains 106 Fable 5.1 references and later safety/capability comparisons, but no nominal total or activated-parameter column for it. Parameter hits refer to harness or effort controls; it provides no sized-base lineage for Fable 5.1.

name.note: Exact model name and API identifier match.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the officially named Claude Fable line.

release_date.note: Exact-model documentation explicitly says released September 1, corroborated by the product page. The news listing's September 15 date conflicts and is not treated as earliest release.

open_weights.note: Exact-model access documentation describes hosted services; Anthropic separately explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the commercial hosted model; not an SPDX weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review found no published nominal total in the exact specifications, launch, 212-page original or later 5.5 comparison cards. Explicit identical-weight lineage to Mythos 5.1 is established, but that model also has no disclosed count; predecessor Fable 5 supplies neither a published size nor a size-preserving relationship. Focused exact-name searches for parameter count, billion/trillion size and sized-base lineage found no additional primary disclosure.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh review checked active/activated counts separately, including current specification tables and all three later 5.5 cards. No active-parameter value or column was found; effort settings and internal activations are not parameter counts. The identical-weight Mythos 5.1 relationship provides no active count, and no dense/MoE or total-to-active assumption is made.

architecture.note: No architecture class disclosed in the checked original and later cards. Exact-name Anthropic research and transformer-circuits.pub searches found no additional primary disclosure. Training descriptions and benchmark-task architecture references do not establish this model architecture.

modalities.note: Text/image to text is explicit; PDF is retained as a supported document input format, not a separate neural modality.

tool_call.note: Official current-model overview explicitly includes tool use for this lineup.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter-only re-audit retains null/undisclosed nominal total and active counts after reopening the exact specifications, launch, Transparency Hub and system-card index, independently inspecting the 212-page exact card and 319-page predecessor card, and checking later 230/148/144-page Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 comparisons. The same-weight Mythos 5.1 lead is explicit but supplies no published size; Fable 5 predecessor wording is not a sized-base inference. Focused searches for total/active counts, billion/trillion sizes and named lineage found no additional primary disclosure. Other field assessments and prior non-parameter corrections are preserved.
